body:
Why was my application denied? :

Kyoal says: 

[Denied] - I am sorry to say your application has been denied for the following reasons:

- More community interaction.

You may not submit another application. Thanks for applying!

But I've been in the forum for more than a year.
Also if it is for lack of posts, I have 8 pages.
I would like you to re-open my application.

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Being on the forums for over a year doesn't matter really. You've only been posting in the last 2 weeks.
If you look here: https://avicus.net/tomi_ca#posts
You only started being active on the forums on February 25th.
We look for people who have been active on the forums for months, not just in the last few weeks.
Your application will not be re-opened as the reason is valid.

Cheers,
Cammy
